title: Great game, but...
content:
So first off, I wanna say that this is my go to slot app. Lots of variety in slots (many real slots from casinos.) they’ve added lots of extra features (bingo balls, timed prizes, leagues, honey-do lists, etc.)  but having been playing this since before all these features, the biggest drawback is that the game (or devs) are always adjusting the win/lose ratio. You can get in a win streak and win big, but then you go on a losing streak and can’t win anything big. 

In the past, one could chalk it up to the gambling mentality of you’re going to lose. But with all these new features, it’s easy to see that it’s not the case. For example, on the competition, you can see how others are doing compared to you. I’ve found that when I’m on a winning streak, many others are as well. The third place person usually has in the billions, as do I. But when I’m on a losing streak, many others are as well, as the third place score is around 20 to 50 million. Just playing the odds, but the top scores should statistically stay the same level.

So something is causing the win/loss ratio to be adjusted (akin to tightening the slots). The reason this is a problem is that many of the features aren’t adjusted to compensate for this loose or tightness of the game. 

The bingo game is kind of fun, as they have different patterns that you have to fill in. However, it seems like no matter what you most always have to do a blackout, since the last few balls to fill in are the last ones that do fill in. This is a problem because the only way to get bingo balls is by winning prizes from big wins (and the 3 balls they give you daily) but when the game is tight, it’s very difficult to get big wins, and therefore hard get many bingo balls. 

They should adjust these items since they are adjusting the win/loss ratios. Like they should have other ways to get bingo balls, or lower the amount needed to earn a prize. Right now it’s like you have to win 25x your bet in order to get a prize.

author: gunn er knive
title: So far, so good….*updated after time*
content:
I’ve only been playing this app for a day so it’s too soon to tell you how it is long term, but so far it’s been great. Not an ad filled mess, or constant purchase pop ups. I really enjoy these slot games and have played probably close to 25 or so. I can tell you that some only last 5-10 minutes and I delete. I have one that has lasted over a month, but it’s close to delete as well for one reason; in these games as you lvl up, it becomes nearly impossible to win. I think they create them that way to get you to purchase, but it’s a bad game mechanic. Will this one be like all of the others? Or will it stand the test of time? If i enjoy playing it for a while, I generally make a few purchases. If not it gets deleted. I will come back and update this after some play time, but I have high hopes for this one. Fun slots, big wins, and lots of side games to help with chips. Give it a try, and see for yourself.
*update* Well, it turns out that it’s just like all of the other slot apps, and as soon as you hit higher lvls (around lvl 70 or so) that you just can’t hit a jackpot to save your life. I counted my spins and after I hit 1 trillion in *chips* I spun 273 times in Huff n Puffs and did not hit one single bonus.  I always get the same responses from the developers and it’s something like this; “ we understand your frustration and appreciate your detailed feedback. We do not control the game or the wins and losses” Well then how is it that every app is the same way? When you start playing you get all kinds of huge wins, and it’s so much fun. Then you level up and cannot hit ANYTHING on ANY slot? Just once I’d like to hear the truth, and tell me that the game is designed to make you spend money. But they would never tell you that. I get it. They don’t create these apps for fun, and they need to make money, but to me it seems like a more logical approach is to just leave the slots with their real odds. In slots, the machines are designed to slowly take your money, and payouts are basically set to keep you playing. Each machine has a risk vs reward, and they even post that information on the machine itself, or in the forums inside the game information. With these apps, it is absolutely tampered with. 
Anyway, the game is decent. I had to deduct 2 stars but it is still a good slot app. Graphics are good, gameplay is fun at lower levels. There was a bit of an issue with glitching, but other than that I would say this is a solid 3.5 stars. Give it a try, spin until you hit the wall, make a small purchase to support the developers and move on. Good luck!
